newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Boston Scientific estimates.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Boston Scientific estimates.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers raised earnings estimates and its target price for Boston Scientific Corp on Monday, the brokerage firm said in a research report.

-- Analyst Amelia McDonald said based on discussions with management, she raised 1997 profit estimates to $2.12 and 1998 to $2.83. The company indicated continued strong sales growth, reduced "forward spend" and the expected impact of the acquisition of Target Therapeutics Inc.
-- The 12-month price target was raised to $80-$85, the research report said.
-- Shares rose 1-1/4 to 65-3/4 in early trading on Monday.
